ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity dark grey/black pixels visible across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a broad contiguous white field with dark micro-mottling along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a dark central region with a large, high-contrast white patch occupying the distal third.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a narrow, well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge, particularly prominent on the right lobe with multiple sharp peaks (5-8 pixels in height relative to local baseline); left lobe edge partially obscured by high-velocity water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tip and along the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical, roughly parallel linear disruptions of lighter intensity (rake marks) visible on the dark pigmented area of the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical rake marks on the right lobe and barnacle colonization at the right lobe tip.
